title: Global Aerospace announces retirement of Jeffrey Bruno, president and group chief underwriting officer
summary: Effective Jan. 1, 2027, Eric Donofrio will assume the role of president, in addition to continuing as chief underwriting officer.
body_markdown:
[Global Aerospace](https://www.global-aero.com/) , a provider of aviation and aerospace insurance, announced that Jeffrey Bruno, president, Global Aerospace, Inc. and group chief underwriting officer, will retire at the end of the year following an exceptional career spanning nearly four decades with the company.


Effective Jan. 1, 2027, Eric Donofrio will assume the role of president, in addition to continuing as chief underwriting officer.


Throughout his tenure, Bruno has played a pivotal role in shaping Global Aerospace, demonstrating unwavering commitment to clients, brokers and the wider aviation industry. He is respected across the market for his integrity, deep expertise and thoughtful leadership.


Bruno has championed innovation and digital transformation alongside coaching and developing the next generation of aviation professionals.


Reflecting on his career, Bruno said: “Looking back, I feel fortunate to have worked with such exceptional people. Together, we developed talent, set high standards, and led a digital transformation that will continue to shape our industry and inspire what comes next.”


Rachel Barrie, group chief executive, shared: “Jeff’s vision and dedication have left a lasting impact not only on Global Aerospace but also on the broader aviation community. We thank him for his outstanding contributions and wish him every happiness in his well-earned retirement.”


Donofrio joined Global Aerospace, Inc. in March 2025 as chief underwriting officer and has quickly established himself as a respected leader with a clear vision for the future.


Donofrio will continue building on the company’s strong foundation while leading its next chapter of growth and service to its clients.


Commenting on his appointment, Donofrio said: “I am excited to work alongside our talented colleagues to further strengthen our capabilities and continue delivering exceptional value, service and support to our clients, their brokers and the aviation industry we serve.”


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Global Aerospace.*
